sources: Provided DOCX texts and original map photographs
Uploaded Aurora DEVELOPER.md and compiled Windows bundle
interpretation: Authorial world rules and developing hypotheses are recorded separately from implemented mechanics. Spoken spellings remain tentative where noted.

records.text: Rose is the third game after Thorns and Stem. It reuses their survival, dialogue, characterization and contract foundation without inventing an ending for either prior game.

Original pre-rendered 3D-to-2D assets, a fixed dimetric view, six local hex directions, AP combat, contextual Look/Use/Item/Skill actions and a CRT presentation. Overworld journeys select any accessible land point and enter local fields explicitly.
Druid/natural, nano and cyber-neon form one artistic continuum. Regional signatory lighting follows authored motifs rather than applying one universal neon palette.
Environmental change includes weather, degradation, growth, decay and construction. Character preparation, skill, situation and faction standing influence the work.

Africa is the closest approximate size comparison. The perceived environment is compared with square planetary coverage; monuments defy comprehension. No exact dimensions or kilometer conversion are fixed.
A perceived continent is a coalescence of interacting indivisible info-particles, with complex geometric instances and fractal influence. Unknown forces are part of the setting.
records.status: author-confirmed lore; abstract particle foundation implemented

records.text: Every registered info-particle retains identity through movement, form change, degradation and transfer. A field inspector can isolate and export its current state for fractal study.

void_null is tangible and traversable, not an inaccessible visual backdrop. Interacts and apogean geometric constructs can present unfamiliar properties. Perception and preparedness determine what a traveler can resolve.
records.status: implemented branching text expedition; geometric fiction recorded

records.text: Apogean denotes a prospect/perspective of an infinite geometric construct. A local reading is measurable within its moment even when the entire construct cannot be perceived.

Upper-left ENACT_HILLS is an administrative region. Its network, light projection and memetic advertisements influence the wider environment. The collective behind this office lacks ordinary public visibility.

Beyond ENACT, a cusp resembles a waterfall off the world edge into geometric iterations. Administrative operations siphon interacts for energy/material generation. The reasons and administrator generation remain developing lore.
records.status: developing author hypothesis; geography not assigned

records.text: RED>GATE> is a lower-right field, possibly a trail of arcane energy through particulate layers. Shell-like constructs may connect to an arcane mollusk aesthetic associated with Snowl Wood; their origin is a hypothesis.

The southern MEZZ/Mezzes metropolis has a north and south, and a perceived endless interior reminiscent of labyrinth/backroom spaces. Civilian, contract and Pilgrim lives continue through and beneath freeways. A southern page is still forthcoming.

Life-String .co provides deliberately designed protection for expeditions into void_null. Administrators contract for extraction of obtains, interacts and fractals. Protective equipment is connected to the setting's life-string account of a person.
records.status: author-confirmed lore; scoped expedition preparation adapted

records.text: Immunix is a luminous blue preparation associated with extracted Darkwood materials. A recorded dose helps hold stance, semblance and perception through each newly encountered interact; finite supplies limit an expedition's preparation.
records.status: author-confirmed lore; finite outward-interact supplies implemented

records.text: Absolutix is a provisional spoken name for a refined consolidation/solidifier preparation that counters repeated administrative percept overlays. This is protection from influence, not a verified engine permission or automatic credential.

Company-made bronze-like metal orbs can consolidate a person's biomods, arcane ink, fractal tendencies and consciousness as an engram/save state. Contract enforcement and AI/unit uploads are described uses.
Natural cultures and environments participate in reciprocal flows of life, energy and expansion. Druid-punk is a useful part of the spectrum, and not the exclusive definition of this world.
Corporations provide housing, provisions, equipment access and contracts while exerting social expectations. They are not universally evil. Pilgrims bridge contract society and subsistence life.

Resource access often depends on contracts, reputation and regulated extraction. Physical goods have changed significance under meta-break and meta-finger technology; prior trade balances are prototype rules, not an assertion of canonical money economics.
records.status: author-confirmed direction; comprehensive economy redesign reserved

records.text: Regulated Meta-Fingers connect neurological function to a projection/extraction field. Injury stories and protective advertising contribute to corporate authority. Sampling transfers a real retained particle, and does not create free material.
records.status: author-confirmed lore; particle transfer and existing mod gates implemented

records.text: KHO and Pyry are signatory intelligences associated with network oversight. Pyry is connected to ENACT and city readouts, functioning in an OS-like role rather than as a public office with universal visible access.
Fractech information pillars provide contracts, weather and directions across a distributed network, rather than one central public office. Signatory intelligences exercise layered oversight.
records.status: author-confirmed lore; dialogue and existing pillars retained

records.text: The Great Web coalesces beneath WN_TOWER, extends far underground and across the perceived continent, and has connections beyond ordinary Fractech scope. Corporate connections and unknown branches remain.

Aqua-sphere is antiquated military technology associated with liquids, water/metal relations and changing material properties under meta-break. Its link to the Great Web is described; exact mechanisms and access remain unspecified.

EUNIX is a pervasive bio-nano cloud/biomod associated with skin pores, healing, data collection and preservation. UNIX, newnix and other spoken variants are retained as aliases rather than separate new species.
records.status: author-confirmed lore; particle form tracked, full physiology reserved

records.text: Perceptual strain is derived from interaction and preparation, not a hard fictional edge of reality. Tools and faction access can make changes legible. The current engine has finite storage and numerical precision.
records.status: implemented strain/preparation; physical hardware limit recorded

records.text: The supplied Aurora program is a resonance simulator with abstract units, object properties, compatibility, pair forces, RAS, emergent formations and fractal visualization. Its compiled source differs from some guide equations; the adapter documents the differences.

The author reports a time-crystal result and a prior scientific proposal/review. The supplied package contains simulation labels and heuristics; no experimental data or peer-review document has been supplied in this turn.
records.status: author report retained; no experimental verification claimed

records.text: Up to two companion NPCs keep descriptions, lore, personal items, stats, attitude, reputation, work cycles, skill checks and bounded survival needs. Their decisions and refusal stay registered.
records.status: implemented existing foundation; construction support added

records.text: Text intentions and optional local model prose support rich descriptions. The server owns validated state and consequences; an optional narrator does not grant powers, objects, credentials or completed actions.

The earlier request to raise .json Engram upload capacity informs a larger Rose particle-import envelope: 192 KiB on the host and a 180,000-byte file limit. Ordinary requests retain 64 KiB. Endcap engram capture/upload remains future work; this release does not modify the separate Engram application.
records.status: Rose particle JSON threshold increased; separate Engram/Endcap work retained
